user.title: Set up Hestia Heating
user.description:
Hestia Heating reads your thermostats (Versatile Thermostat first), your pellet stove and your schedules, and says what heats, why and what comes next. **It controls nothing.**

Everything else is set in the Heating tab of the Hestia-FB panel.
